Usage: psi replicate|rep [options]

Replicates an asset database from source to destination location.

Options:
  --db <path>                 The directory that contains the media file
                              database
  --dest <path>               The destination directory that specifies the
                              target database
  -k, --key <keyfile>         Path to the private key file for encryption.
  --dk, --dest-key <keyfile>  Path to destination encryption key file
  -g, --generate-key          Generate encryption keys if they don't exist.
                              (default: false)
  -p, --path <path>           Replicate only files matching this path (file or
                              directory)
  --partial                   Create a partial replica: copy only metadata and
                              structure; asset files are fetched on demand from
                              origin.
  --full                      Create a full replica: copy all original, display,
                              and thumbnail files (default when --yes is used).
  --force                     Proceed with replication without confirmation,
                              even if destination database exists, and allow
                              replication between databases with different IDs
                              (THIS IS DANGEROUS, use it carefully, use it
                              rarely)
  -v, --verbose               Enables verbose logging. (default: false)
  --tools                     Enables output from media processing tools
                              (ImageMagick, ffmpeg, etc.). (default: false)
  -y, --yes                   Non-interactive mode. Use command line arguments
                              and defaults. (default: false)
  --cwd <path>                Set the current working directory for directory
                              selection prompts. Defaults to the current
                              directory from your shell/terminal. This is mostly
                              for testing/debugging.
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Examples:
  psi replicate --db ./photos --dest ./backup Replicates a database to a backup location.
  psi replicate --db . --dest s3:bucket/photos Replicates the current database to S3.

Usage: psi verify|ver [options]

Verifies the integrity of the media file database by checking file hashes.

Options:
  --db <path>          The directory that contains the media file database
  -k, --key <keyfile>  Path to the private key file for encryption.
  -v, --verbose        Enables verbose logging. (default: false)
  --tools              Enables output from media processing tools (ImageMagick,
                       ffmpeg, etc.). (default: false)
  -y, --yes            Non-interactive mode. Use command line arguments and
                       defaults. (default: false)
  --full               Force full verification (bypass cached hash optimization)
                       (default: false)
  -p, --path <path>    Verify only files matching this path (file or directory)
  --workers <number>   Number of worker threads to use for parallel processing
                       (default: number of CPU cores)
  --timeout <ms>       Task timeout in milliseconds (default: 600000 = 10
                       minutes)
  --cwd <path>         Set the current working directory for directory selection
                       prompts. Defaults to the current directory from your
                       shell/terminal. This is mostly for testing/debugging.
  -h, --help           display help for command

Examples:
  psi verify --db .                Verifies a database in the current directory.
  psi verify --db ./photos         Verifies a database in the ./photos directory.
  psi verify --db ./photos --full  Forces full verification of all files.
